series.title: Still Home

qc.notes: Every episode is FOUR shots of ONE real, world-recognisable city in the year 2512, and the subject of every episode is a piece of ADVANCED WORKING TECHNOLOGY that the city built and runs. SHOT 1 IS AERIAL: the camera is high in the open sky, above every rooftop, tower and mast, looking down, and the whole city fills the frame. Fail shot 1 if the camera is at ground level, indoors, or underneath a roof, canopy, bridge or shelter, and fail it if the city does not read as seen from the air. SHOT 2 IS GROUND LEVEL among people. SHOT 3 IS A CLOSE VIEW OF THE TECHNOLOGY ITSELF while it works. SHOT 4 IS ONE SMALL WARM DETAIL of everyday home life. Fail the episode if no world-famous landmark or skyline is recognisable, if the place is an invented or generic location, if the four shots do not read as the same city, or if no advanced technology is visibly working. THIS CHANNEL SHOWS A CITY THAT ADVANCED, NOT A CITY THAT SURVIVED A CATASTROPHE: rubble, ruins, cracked or damaged structure, makeshift or salvaged construction, scaffolding of lashed poles, tarpaulin shelters, floodwater standing in streets, sandstorms, smoke, fire, corpses, panic, warfare, weapons, refugee camps and abandoned emptiness are automatic failures. A merely old, weathered, pre-industrial or present-day-looking city with no visible advanced technology is also a failure. Close-ups of faces are automatic failures, and so is any human figure whose hands, limbs or body read as malformed. Readable on-screen text, captions, subtitles, lettering on signs or panels, logos and watermarks are automatic failures because the title card is burned in afterwards. SHOT 1 MUST CARRY A SILHOUETTE: the advanced technology has to be a physical structure that changes the city's outline against the sky and it must already be complete and running; fail shot 1 if the only futuristic element is a glow or light strip laid over a city that is otherwise the present-day one, and fail it if the technology switches on, brightens, unfolds or assembles during the shot instead of being fully there from the start. SHOT 2 MUST CARRY TRAVERSAL: fail shot 2 if nothing large crosses the frame and the scene is people standing still. Record any of these under issues.
qc.first_frame_rule: This is a city-scale AERIAL frame, so there is no single close-up object to look for; judge the frame as a whole. Two things must be true at once in this exact frame. FIRST, the city must be a real, world-famous one and its landmark or skyline must be recognisable here. SECOND, the episode's advanced technology must be a PHYSICAL STRUCTURE that visibly changes the shape of the city against the sky, and it must already stand complete and fully operating in this frame. Set first_frame_ok to false if this frame could pass as a photograph of that city as it exists today, if the only futuristic element is a glow, a light strip or a coloured surface added to otherwise present-day buildings, if the technology reads as dark, dim, switched off, half built or still appearing, or if you cannot tell which real city this is.

Bu yuzden art_style tabela, yazi, ekran ve logo ISTEMEZ; yazinin isini boyali sembol ve renk alani yapar.
series.music_fixed: A single sustained sub-bass drone at one steady level for the whole duration, built from deep low-frequency air and distant structural resonance. It holds the same volume from the first second to the last, stays free of percussion, rhythm, melody, vocals and high frequencies, and ends mid-tone so the loop is seamless.

art_style: Photoreal documentary footage of a real, named present-day city as it exists in the year 2512, composed for vertical 9:16 at 24 fps. The city's genuine geography and its world-famous landmarks stay recognisable at credible scale, carried forward and built upon by five centuries of engineering. Advanced working technology is the subject of the frame: precision-machined alloy and glass, luminous structural edges, autonomous machines moving with purpose, transit gliding along its own lines, energy reading as steady light. Natural motivated light mixes with the engineered glow of the city itself; restrained documentary colour, deep shadows, fine machined texture, stable exposure and clear scale cues give the image the clarity and grain of real aerial and street photography. Surfaces are immaculate and continuously maintained by the machines that live on them. The city is prosperous, busy and bright: lit interiors, moving crowds, cargo in motion and engineered green establish a place that is doing well. Painted symbols and pure colour fields do the work that lettering would, so every surface stays clear of readable words. The frame edge is the image edge and the view is unobstructed. The mood is confident, advanced and warm.
